claims.statement: Tom Allen was to fight Mike McCoole on November 10, 1869, within fifty miles of Cincinnati.
claims.excerpt:
The approaching fight between Mike McCoole and
Tom Allen, to come off within fifty miles of Cincin-
nati, on the 10thof next month

claims.statement: Tom Allen had numerous friends in Cincinnati, judging by the tone of the Cincinnati press.
claims.excerpt:
Judging from the tone of the Cincianati press Allen
has numerous friends there

fights.excerpt:

fights.notes: Scheduled fight; not yet held in this article.

notes: Hint's date of November 10, 1869 is confirmed by the text ('the 10th of next month' in an October 26 paper).
